title: Review of order
description: Review of an order passed by the District Commission

steps.step: The District Commission identifies an error apparent on the face of the record or receives an application from a party within thirty days of the order
The District Commission reviews the order
State Commission identifies error apparent on the face of the record or receives an application from a party within thirty days of the order
Error apparent on the face of the record is identified
Application made by any of the parties within thirty days of the order, or the National Commission acts on its own motion
